# Prompt: Component Governance

## Objective
Audit component library coherence and define consolidation actions.

## Prompt
```text
@component-inventory-mapper cataloga todos los componentes, detecta duplicados y propone plan de consolidacion.
Incluye variantes requeridas, deudas de accesibilidad y gaps de documentacion.
```

## Expected Output
- Component inventory.
- Duplicate/conflict list.
- Consolidation plan by impact and effort.
